title: An Ecopath with Ecosim model of the Western and Central Pacific Ocean warm-pool pelagic ecosystem
quality_rationale: Inherited loadability and documentation assessment; spatial fit rescored for this EEZ. Regional warm-pool pelagic model; fixed bounds 110–180 E and 15 S–15 N. Pooled food web, not an island reef or nationally resolved EEZ model. Bibliographic/spatial correction:  Primary WCPFC landing lists downloadable SC3_EB_IP8.pdf. Bounds explicitly 110–180°E and 15°N–15°S; not blanket western-central Pacific EEZ coverage. Primary 42-page 2007 report Section 2.2 explicitly states fixed 110–180 E,15 N–15 S; Section 2.3 states 31 final functional groups. Do not conflate with later 44-group 140–180 E/10 N–15 S warm-pool models. Report includes parameter, diet and catch tables; no native model file verified.
